canceled_void_policy: canceled and void outcomes are excluded and counted separately; they never receive a score
conflict_policy: a self-contradicting outcome row is excluded, counted and preserved; it is never repaired to make a member scorable

declared_baselines.base_rate_brier: Brier of a constant forecast equal to the observed prevalence within this experiment's own matured members

end_condition: sample floor reached AND minimum_matured_fraction satisfied
evaluation_horizons: market close time plus a 3600s settlement grace

feature_definitions.domain: research packet domain at forecast time

forecast_version: as recorded per member and reported in composition
hypothesis: Brier skill versus the base-rate benchmark remains at or below zero for tennis forecasts created after start_time.
invalidating_conditions: any automated change to tennis forecasting during collection, which this milestone does not authorize and would end the experiment
tennis arrival rate cannot reach the floor within 120 days
known_limitations: the current tennis observation is n=129 with skill -0.0368 and the worst recorded calibration; a floor of 200 is a modest increase and may still be inconclusive
this is a falsification attempt, not a repair; no model change is authorized or implied by it
market_population: Kalshi tennis markets discovered by the standard scan
missing_data_policy: members whose markets have not matured are counted as pending and excluded from the metric; never imputed
multiple_testing_policy: one primary metric; the directional secondary is descriptive only and cannot be promoted or substituted
null_hypothesis: Brier skill versus the base-rate benchmark is strictly positive.

rationale: Tennis forecasts created on or after registration, from any forecaster family; composition is reported rather than filtered.

REPAIRED: the draft previously excluded rows that were 'not scored_current at evaluation'. That made membership a function of the outcome pipeline's progress — the cohort would have become 'the rows that happened to get scored'. Membership now uses only forecast-time fields.
Evaluation policy, which is NOT membership: pending rows remain pending; unscorable rows are reported; sample-floor and matured-fraction rules determine evaluability.

window_end is declared 'unbounded' deliberately: the end condition is the sample floor plus matured fraction, not a calendar date. Declaring it explicitly is what stops an evaluator choosing the end after seeing results.

provider_policy: no new provider and no paid provider; the existing read-only Kalshi market-detail path only, at the cadence MarketOps already runs
research_question: Does tennis continue to fail to beat its base-rate benchmark on forecasts created after registration?

result_protocol.data_quality_invalidation_policy: a member whose persisted score disagrees with its current outcome is counted unscorable; if such members exceed half the cohort the evaluation is invalidated rather than reported
result_protocol.protocol_deviation_policy: any unsupported metric, baseline, decision rule or CI policy, and any unmet stopping condition, is recorded and blocks a favorable verdict

safety_boundary: measurement only; no expected value, recommendation, sizing, order, wallet or capital behavior is produced or implied, and calibration is not an edge claim

signal_definitions.none: no signal gating; every eligible forecast enters

stale_score_policy: only scored_current members enter; stale rows are excluded
start_condition: the first forecast whose created_at is at or after start_time; no forecast existing at registration is eligible
stopping_rule: a single evaluation once the sample floor and matured fraction are both satisfied; no interim looks, and the experiment is not stopped early on a favourable reading
title: Tennis base-rate falsification
